desc: Prove equivalence: g achievable iff g|A_i and cnt[g]>=K, so answer = max valid divisor d of A_i.
Implement freq counting over 1..M and prime sieve up to M.
Compute cnt[d] via multiple-zeta transform (prime p: d from M//p down to 1, cnt[d]+=cnt[d*p]).
Threshold to f[d]=d if cnt[d]>=K else 0, then compute ans via max-zeta transform (prime p: x from 1 to M//p, f[x*p]=max(f[x*p],f[x])).
Map each A_i to ans[A_i] and write N lines with fast I/O.
Test sample inputs, edge cases (K=1, K=N, duplicates, single element) and large-constraint performance.
